name: media-stack
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Tier 3 worker that bundles the 7 shipped media plugins (image, voice, music, video, ffmpeg) into one dispatchable roster. Use it for any multi-deliverable media production: tutorial videos, ad cuts, narrated slide decks, social clips, podcast covers, etc. The engine dispatches to individual plugins based on the master objective; this manifest is the named roster the LLM (or operator) references instead of writing one plugin per call.

plugin_roster.purpose: Hero / cover art for the deliverable (one per project; sometimes one per slide). Wraps minimax-image.
plugin_roster.when_to_dispatch: Once at the start (cover); once per slide for slide-deck style projects.
When the source names a character, speaker, or subject that needs a visual identity.

plugin_roster.purpose: Text-to-speech narration per slide or per scene. Wraps minimax-tts.
plugin_roster.when_to_dispatch: Once per slide / scene when the source has spoken copy.
Once for the full project (a single BGM that loops under the narration), or once per chapter if the project has multiple moods.

plugin_roster.purpose: Cinematic B-roll video clips. Wraps minimax-hailuo-2.3.
plugin_roster.when_to_dispatch: When a slide or scene needs motion video, not just a still image.

plugin_roster.purpose: Motion graphics, kinetic typography, logo reveals, infographic animation. Wraps minimax-h3.
plugin_roster.when_to_dispatch: When a slide needs animated text or data viz rather than a filmed clip.

plugin_roster.purpose: Local ffmpeg for the final assembly step: trim, concatenate voiceover + BGM, mux into the final MP4. No LLM; just calls ffmpeg on the host.
plugin_roster.when_to_dispatch: Once at the end, as the packager step that produces the final deliverable.

continuity_rules_default: All heroes use the same cover style (one of: cinematic | minimalist | vintage | modern | abstract) so the project is visually coherent.
All voiceover uses the same voice (one of: default | male-1 | female-1 | child) so the project sounds like one narrator.
All BGM uses the same musical genre / mood; crossfade between chapters is allowed but per-slide genre switching is not.
Aspect ratio is fixed per project (16:9 for desktop, 9:16 for short-form, 1:1 for social) -- no per-slide aspect switching.
Color grading is consistent across heroes: the LLM should pass the same color-palette hint in every image prompt (e.g. 'cool teal and warm amber, low contrast').
self_heal_targets: Tone drift (voiceover shifts formality between scenes)
Style drift (hero images drift in art style between slides)
Pacing mismatch (voiceover duration doesn't match the slide's visual hold time)
Audio level mismatch (voiceover too quiet vs BGM, or vice versa)
Color drift (hero images don't share the same palette)

default_hitl_gates.ask: Approve the storyboard + voiceover script for media generation?

default_hitl_gates.fires_after: all hero images + voiceover + BGM generated
default_hitl_gates.ask: Approve the visual + audio assembly for final cut?
Approve the final pack for delivery to deliverables/<project>/?
